defs.def: the act of showing sth or of giving sth to sb 提交；授予；颁发；出示

ex.s: I held presentations at schools to teach kids about plastic waste.
ex.t: 我在学校做了演讲教孩子们关于塑料废物的知识。

ex.s: As students, it’s likely that those moments are mainly about school life, such as sitting a major exam, giving a presentation, or becoming a boarder for the first time.
ex.t: 作为学生，那些时刻很可能主要与学校生活有关，比如参加一次重要的考试、做一次演讲，或者第一次成为寄宿生。

defs.def: the way in which sth is offered, shown, explained, etc. to others 提出（或展示、解释等）的方式

ex.s: When is the class presentation according to Vicky?
ex.t: 根据维基的说法，课堂展示是在什么时候？

ex.s: I guess I was better than the others, for Miss Chevalier asked a while later, “Addie, I was wondering if you would recite the whole poem to the Saturday evening’s club.” She said a famous professor was going to give a lecture about the poet, and a presentation of that poem would be a fresh way to start.
ex.t: 我想我比其他人强一些，因为谢瓦利埃小姐过了一会儿问道："艾迪，我在想你是否愿意在周六晚上的读书会上把整首诗背诵出来。"她说一位著名教授将要做一个关于这位诗人的讲座，而朗诵那首诗会是一个新颖的开场方式。

ex.s: （3）Among the items provided by the school for a visual presentation are     ．
ex.t: （3）学校为视觉呈现提供的物品包括     。

ex.s: Performance： A dramatic presentation of the topic no more than 10 minutes long． If special clothes are used， they should truly represent a given period．
ex.t: 表演：对该主题进行的戏剧性展示，时长不超过10分钟。若使用了特殊服装，应真实代表某个特定时期。

defs.def: a meeting at which sth, especially a new product or idea, or piece of work, is shown to a group of people 展示会；介绍会；发布会

ex.s: Besides performing and modeling, Hannah travels the world given/giving presentations and talks, getting more people involved/involving in the conservation of ocean life.
ex.t: 除了表演和模特工作，汉娜还在世界各地做演讲和讲座，让更多人参与到海洋生物保护中来。

defs.def: the series of computer slides (= images) that accompany the talk when sb gives a presentation at a meeting 幻灯片演示

ex.s: Documentary： A visual presentation （such as a video， slide show， or computer project） no more than 10 minutes long． A desktop computer， screen， projector， and loudspeakers will be available． Students must provide their presentations on CDs before Friday， March 23．
ex.t: 纪录片：一种视觉展示（如视频、幻灯片或电脑作品），时长不超过10分钟。将提供台式电脑、屏幕、投影仪和扬声器。学生必须在3月23日星期五之前将展示内容刻录在CD上提交。

ex.s: General information Main idea Lesson(s) in the work 1 the structure of your presentation 2 useful words, expressions and structures Write a reflection after completing this unit.
ex.t: 基本信息 主要思想 作品中的教训 1 你的演示结构 2 有用的词、表达和结构 完成本单元后写一篇反思。

ex.s: One day, I attended a presentation by wildlife conservationist Grant Brown at my high school.
ex.t: 一天，我在高中参加了野生动物保护主义者格兰特·布朗的讲座。

ex.s: His presentation not only awed and inspired me, but also helped emerge an inner desire to make a difference in the world.
ex.t: 他的演讲不仅让我惊叹和受到启发，还帮助唤起一种想在世界有所作为的内在渴望。

ex.s: How did Grant Brown’s presentation influence Alice?
ex.t: Grant Brown的演讲对Alice产生了什么影响？

ex.s: Always make your presentation just a bit shorter than anticipated.
ex.t: 让听众意犹未尽比让他们在座位上不安地扭动、等待演讲结束要好。

ex.s: Learning activities homework exam Changes 1 the structure of your presentation 2 useful words, expressions and structures Write a reflection after completing this unit.
ex.t: 学习活动 作业考试 改变 1 您的演示文稿结构 2 有用的单词，表达式和结构 完成这个单元后写一个反射。

ex.s: Why people go to war Effects of war on people How we can maintain peace around the world 1 the structure of your presentation 2 useful words, expressions and structures Write a reflection after completing this unit.
ex.t: 人们为何会走向战争 战争对人的影响 我们如何在全世界维护和平 1 你的演示结构 2 有用的词、表达和结构 完成本单元后写一篇反思。

defs.def: a ceremony or formal occasion during which a gift or prize is given 颁奖仪式；赠送仪式

ex.s: I went to my teacher’s office after the award presentation.
ex.t: 颁奖后我去了老师办公室。

ex.s: I went to my teacher’s office after the award presentation.
ex.t: 颁奖后我去了老师办公室。

defs.def: a performance of a play, etc. in a theatre （戏剧等的）上演，演出
the position in which a baby is lying in the mother's body just before birth （胎儿的）临产胎位，产式，先露位置
